ambiguity_flags.note: The proposed term 'truth_store' maps ambiguously to three governed concepts: (1) LAYER_2 — the architectural layer the rename intends to replace; (2) SNAPSHOT_TRUTH — the established canonical concept for the immutable snapshot boundary state; (3) SNAPSHOTS_TABLE — the physical 'snapshots' table that stores snapshot metadata. The 'store' suffix implies a data-storage artifact, not an architectural boundary with contract obligations. This blurs the snapshot publication boundary (Category A) and weakens phase-gate semantics (Category B). Fail-closed finding: the term is not adoptable under current canonical table without a constitutional-level canonical term table amendment.

The proposed term 'decision_layer' is intended as a label for the entire LAYER_3 architectural layer, but 'decision engine' — a term the canonical table explicitly marks as discouraged for LAYER_3 — also refers to a specific named planned component within Layer-3 per CLAUDE.md Section 3.2 (Feature Builder, Index Suite, Regime Gate, Supervisor Engine, Decision Engine, DecisionPacket generator, Execution Layer). 'decision_layer' is closer in form to 'decision engine' than any currently discouraged variant and would amplify the existing name-collision risk. Downstream governance steps reading 'decision_layer' could conflate the layer label with the component name. Category D (decision vocabulary) and Category B (phase/readiness) governance-sensitive drift. Fail-closed finding: the term is not adoptable without constitutional-level canonical term table amendment and a formal disambiguation of the Decision Engine component name.
